svg.title: Cascading Dice Table — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A falling tabletop set showing recognizable d4 tetrahedron, d6 cube, d8 octahedron, d10 trapezohedron, d12 dodecahedron, d20 icosahedron, and faceted d100. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
